verdict.rationale: Community evidence directly confirms vue-cli lets developers scaffold projects with official libraries 'very easily,' and Vite (Vue's now-official build tool) is praised for making setup fast; the docs' Getting Started structure also points to onboarding tooling. Missing for 10: first-party documentation snippet showing exact CLI/starter commands (e.g., npm create vue@latest) and independent timing/benchmark evidence of 'few minutes' setup.
